entities.summary: Michael Hesemann is a German historian, Vatican journalist and author. As a student he became known in Germany as an author of several books on UFOs and extraterrestrial visitors on Earth. Later in his career he turned to topics related to Catholicism, history and archaeology. Hesemann represents decidedly conservative-traditional Roman Catholic views.
